lines.text: [Sample tip] Press M on desktop, or tap the little light above your wrist in VR, to open your menu.
[Sample tip] The room dimmers only change your own lights. Do dim with abandon.
[Sample quip] Do mind the gap. There isn't one, but it's good practice.
[Sample quip] Space is very big. The lounge is very cosy. I recommend the lounge.
[Sample joke] I've been reading a book about anti-gravity. I simply can't put it down.
[Sample joke] Why did the lift win an award? It was always raising people's spirits.
[Sample fact] Venus takes longer to spin once than to circle the Sun. I find that rather relaxing.
[Sample fact] Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach the Earth.
